kpis.name: Flights with a boom on the ground
kpis.note: Held out (fit on one half-year, tested on the other): 0.39–0.48% at FL550 with the ensemble margin; 95% upper bound 0.9%

kpis.name: Minutes saved per overland flight
kpis.source: Hindcast study, 53 weeks × 48 routes × 31 GEFS members
kpis.note: Held-out mean of 29.1 and 26.1 min, ensemble margin, FL550

kpis.name: Day-ahead boomless-Mach error
kpis.source: 4,004 IGRA2 launches vs GFS 24 h forecast, 6 US stations, Oct 2025 – Sep 2026 (engine/validate.py, monthly in CI)
kpis.note: RMS of all errors. 6 h before departure 0.0113, 12 h 0.0119, analysis 0.0104 (2,006 launches). Unsafe side only (model allows more than the balloon): 0.0108 at 24 h, 0.0088 at 6 h. Gate metric under review: see Method 6.2

kpis.name: Legs with loudness in psf
kpis.note: Primary boom (Carlson, ±15%); cutoff legs from the Airy caustic model checked against FaINT; secondary booms checked on every over-water leg (landing on land not allowed)

kpis.name: New GFS data to updated map
kpis.note: Hourly check from when the run is complete on AWS

kpis.name: WCAG 2.2 AA checks passed
kpis.note: axe-core, every tab, light/dark/phone, in CI; manual audit pending

phases.name: Precise
phases.gate: Day-ahead error <= 0.010 vs balloons; boom exposure <= 0.5% of flights at the default margin

phases.name: Loudness
phases.gate: Reproduces sBOOM reference cases within 5%; FaINT caustic data within its scatter

phases.name: Operational
phases.gate: One operator or manufacturer runs a 3-month shadow trial

phases.name: Compliant
phases.gate: FAA accepts the method as part of an operator's means of compliance
